stem.text: A fixed resistor and a filament lamp are connected in series to a power supply.
The $I$–$V$ characteristics for the two components are shown.

stem.alt: Graph of I/A against V/V titled fixed resistor, with both axes running from 0 (I/A up to 0.5, V/V up to 10); a straight line starts at the origin and rises across the grid.
Graph of I/A against V/V titled filament lamp, with both axes running from 0 (I/A up to 0.5, V/V up to 10); a curve starts at the origin and rises, becoming less steep.

stem.text: The current in the fixed resistor is $0.34\,\text{A}$.
What is the resistance of the filament lamp?
